title: Further Adventures of Indiana Jones #18 Marvel June 1984 Rope Bridge Cover
conditionDescription: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Further Adventures of Indiana Jones #18 (June 1984), Marvel Comics. Indy on a rope bridge in a Himalayan blizzard. Direct edition, 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Parker Brothers Popeye video game ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
